data.title: Sticker Packs
data.description: Explore multiplication facts using equal groups, arrays, repeated addition, number lines, and area models to solve for missing factors.

challenges.hint: Count by fours until you reach twenty, or think about what number multiplied by four gives twenty.
challenges.narration: Let us find the missing factor. What number multiplied by four gives twenty?

challenges.hint: Think about your threes or sevens. How many groups of three make twenty-one?
challenges.narration: Time for the next puzzle. Seven times what number equals twenty-one?

challenges.hint: Skip count by sevens: seven, fourteen, twenty-one, twenty-eight. How many jumps was that?
challenges.narration: Keep going! What number multiplied by seven equals twenty-eight?

challenges.hint: Double what number gives you fourteen? Or count by twos up to fourteen.
challenges.narration: Almost there. Two times what number equals fourteen?

challenges.hint: Think about your eights multiplication facts. What number times eight is forty-eight?
challenges.narration: Here is our final challenge. What number multiplied by eight gives forty-eight?

data.imagePrompt: colorful sticker packs arranged in neat rows on a bright table
